findings.explanation: Payment is due 45 days after invoice confirmation, which exceeds the standard 30-day payment term and delays your cash flow.
findings.suggested_change: After the Client confirms that invoice contents are correct, the Client shall pay within thirty (30) days after confirming thus.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I hope you are having a good week. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing. - Regarding the timeline where the relevant clause states: "After PC Financial confirms that invoice contents are correct, PC Financial shall pay within 45 days after confirming thus.", this payment period is longer than standard; please modify this to state: "After the Client confirms that invoice contents are correct, the Client shall pay within thirty (30) days after confirming thus." Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
